verdict.rationale: First-party IAM docs say teams can authenticate through Claude for Enterprise, which adds SSO/SAML, domain capture, role-based permissions and a compliance API, or through 'a cloud provider'. The cloud-platform route is only a passing mention, with no named providers or setup details, and SSO depends on the Enterprise plan. Missing for 10: named cloud providers and how to configure cloud authentication, details of the SSO/IdP setup flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can authenticate through an enterprise identity or cloud platform for compliance and scalability

citations.quote: Claude for Enterprise: adds SSO, domain capture, role-based permissions, compliance API, and managed policy settings for organization-wide Claude Code configurations.
teams can use Claude for Teams or Enterprise, the Claude Console, or a cloud provider
